answer: Brittain Dining Hall was originally constructed in 1928 and features Collegiate Gothic architecture, as evidenced by the arched windows and ornate ceiling. A recent two-year renovation has modernized the kitchens and service areas, while retaining the building’s original design elements. The main dining room also features a large stained-glass window. The renovation included updates to the systems within the building.
